title: Text: DET Doug Teter ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I just talked to Al. I don’t like taking “handouts” from him for scoops but I asked him about Stewart. Didn’t sound like the meeting in Philly went great, and there could be a surgery involved. What’s the deal
Basically, he tipped me off. He’s driving home from Lakeland, it’s gonna come out later I think. Lemme know!
